caption: The drawing features two identical green glass bottles, each depicted vertically side by side on a plain, light-colored background. Both bottles are oval-shaped with a short, cylindrical neck at the top. The sides of the bottles are slightly tapered towards the necks. Embossed designs appear within an oval medallion on the face of each bottle. The bottle on the left displays an eagle with spread wings, talons visible, and a curved beak pointing to the left. The bottle on the right shows a bird in profile, perched with its wings partly raised, a ribbon or serpent-like object in its beak, and facing right. Around the medallions on both bottles, there is a repeating circular pattern that follows the contour of the oval shape. The color applied is a translucent green that highlights shading, reflection, and the texture of the glass. The artist's signature, "V. L. VANCE," appears at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Green Glass Flask
